item.title: Moonlight Hike - TooGood Pond, Unionville — Fri Sep 25, 7:00 PM
item.description:
GTA Hiking & Stuff Join me for our first moonlight hike of the season. I plan to post hikes throughout the year during the nights around the full moon. If you haven't experienced a night hike, come out and join the fun. These hike are all about the energy of the moon. We can share interesting facts about that months full moon.
We will hike at a moderate pace doing 5 - 6 km in 2 hrs or less. Please bring a headlamp or a flashlight.
This month we will walk the paths around Toogood Pond in Unionville. The paths have many breaks in the treelines which will allow us to stop several times to admire the moon. Since its Friday night, after the hike we can visit one of the establishments on Main Street and enjoy a chat.
Let's hope it will be clear so we can see the sun at night. The moon can get bright enough to turn off our headlamps while we hike. So if you haven't experienced a night hike, come out and enjoy the adventure. Just don't be the last in line.😬

item.title: Discover new artwork by Alanah Jewell on Union's facade banners and in the Front Street Vitrine — Sun Sep 27 — Union
item.description:
Discover new artwork by Alanah Jewell on Union’s facade banners and in the Front Street Vitrine. Union Presents The Meaning of Connection Sponsored by TD
The Meaning of Connection speaks to how something so small can hold an entire universe of meaning. We often pass a single flower and admire its beauty without thinking about its value; if you magnify that flower, you can see that it is intricately connected to the rest of Creation. The flower is food for the bee, who is a pollinator for plants in a different territory, that are food for the rabbits, who are food for the foxes, who eat the berries that are shaded by the trees, that are homes to the birds, that migrate south and create more life each year, bringing beauty and songs for our southern relatives. That single flower, like each living being, is immensely important. We all have our own version of the flower that helps us stay intricately connected to each other. item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🍂 Fall Walk: From Rosedale to Cherry Street 🌿
### A Fall Walk Through Some of Toronto's Most Interesting Neighbourhoods
Looking for a walk that gives you a little bit of everything? We'll start in **Rosedale**, make our way through **Cabbagetown and Regent Park**, wander through the **Distillery District**, stop at **Biidaasige Park**, and finish with a well-earned meal at **Cherry Street Bar-B-Que**. Along the way, we'll see some of the city's oldest neighbourhoods, newer communities, historic architecture, green spaces, and some pretty great views. It's a longer walk, but the route is more about **exploring Toronto together** than trying to finish as quickly as possible.
